description: This file is a complete HTML document that provides the frontend interface for a database visualizer. It includes markup, styles, and client-side JavaScript for browsing databases, tables, and data, with interactive features such as expanding cells and refreshing the database list.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the entire database list and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a specific table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for the data table based on fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content that is too long or a complex object.
